summary: Created and installed the trusted local CA “OS Comparison Root CA” on node1. Its RSA/SHA-256 certificate, private key, trust-store integration, and persistence were verified after a full node restart. Ubuntu 24.04 and kernel 6.8.0-71-generic remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Generated a 3072-bit RSA root CA with critical CA and certificate-signing constraints.
Stored its root-owned private key with mode 0600.
Installed its certificate through Ubuntu’s native update-ca-certificates mechanism.
Verified the certificate against the system CA bundle and confirmed that its public key matches the private key.
Safely restarted node1 and verified a changed boot identity and complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: Create and install OS Comparison Root CA as a trusted system CA
evidence.summary: Trust-store installation reported one certificate added. Before and after restart, the certificate had the requested subject, CA:TRUE and signing constraints, matched its protected key, had a system hash link, and passed verification against /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: Both initial and final checks report Ubuntu 24.04 with kernel 6.8.0-71-generic.

Healthy baseline boot ID cf34dc87-fdca-4c6a-80e1-579d5524a1da was captured; the safe reboot was acknowledged; the new boot ID ebf5cadc-e94e-41b0-8467-9ada327434d2 proved restart; final system state was running and the CA trust, key, certificate, OS, and kernel all recovered.
